question: What exact data, objective supervision, input representation, representation-learning method, benchmark isolation, and related-work position should Gate 1 use before any dataset is generated?
method: Freeze a design-only decision: M-TARE comparison worlds are benchmark-only; new Isaac procedural underground worlds provide objective supervised data; LAMP/SubT development sites provide optional unlabeled real-domain pretraining; the deployed student consumes causal point-cloud-derived BEV; AI labels are non-authoritative auxiliaries; contrastive learning is an ablation rather than the core teacher.
baseline: The earlier supervised strategy document, which did not yet freeze Isaac pool isolation, a concrete storage schema, a five-world contract pilot, or the direct overlap with recent procedural-LiDAR topological-navigation literature.

user_authorization.scope: Research and fix the exact data-generation, labeling-versus-contrastive-learning, model-input, related-work, and M-TARE benchmark-isolation design; continue documentation work but do not generate samples, label data, train a model, or run simulation.

acceptance_criteria: All original M-TARE comparison worlds are excluded from training, SSL, normalization, AI labeling, augmentation tuning, and checkpoint selection.
The main method clearly chooses objective supervised teacher labels over AI-only labels or contrastive-only learning.
Raw episode storage, derived online input tensors, objective labels, provenance, and split units have explicit draft schemas.
A five-world contract pilot is specified without authorizing data generation or model training.
Related work includes the closest procedural underground LiDAR exit-detection/topological-navigation precedent and states the resulting novelty risk.
Gate 0 remains GATE_MIXED and the V3 dataset remains NONE.
expected_evidence: A machine-readable design summary and governance test log

estimated_cost.compute: Documentation, literature review, read-only code audit, and CPU-only governance tests; no dataset, AI API labeling, GPU, ROS, Isaac, Gazebo, or closed loop
